name: SidebarPanel
label: Sidebar panel
description: Secondary navigation column listing one section's pages, with group headings and one level of accordion nesting.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to list, optionally grouped with `group` and nested one level with `children`

props.name: title
props.description:
Heading at the top of the panel, usually the label of the item that opened it. Also the panel's accessible name, after a native `aria-label`; with neither, the panel is named "Section navigation".
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which SidebarPanel does not expose.

props.name: activeKey
props.description: Key of the item for the current page. Its accordion parent starts open

props.name: defaultOpenKeys
props.description: Keys of the accordion rows open on first render, in addition to the active item's parent

props.name: onCollapse
props.description: Renders a collapse button beside the heading and calls this when it is pressed

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the collapse button. Defaults to "Collapse <title>", or "Collapse panel" when there is no title

props.name: onBack
props.description: Renders a back row above the heading and calls this when it is pressed; the drill-in navigation on small screens

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router. Wins over a LinkProvider's; a plain
`<a>` when neither is set.
